description:
Nature is being destroyed by environmental pollution, and nature evolves to live with humans. Mutant plants that start living as parasites on human bodies, and people who suddenly start to go crazy with anxiety symptoms. Is it parasitism or symbiosis? An unprecedented disaster thriller
